audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Sin, bodily pain, isolation, guilt, enemies, and plea for help.

verses.restored: O YHWH, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

familiar.text: O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

modern.text: O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

original.text: מִזְמ֖וֹר לְדָוִ֣ד לְהַזְכִּֽיר יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל בְּקֶצְפְּךָ֥ תוֹכִיחֵ֑נִי וּֽבַחֲמָתְךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי

verses.restored: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

familiar.text: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

modern.text: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.

original.text: כִּֽי חִ֭צֶּיךָ נִ֣חֲתוּ בִ֑י וַתִּנְחַ֖ת עָלַ֣י יָדֶֽךָ

verses.restored: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.

familiar.text: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.

notes.title: Illness and divine anger
notes.body: The speaker interprets bodily suffering through guilt and divine anger. That is the psalmist’s theological experience, not a universal diagnosis of sickness.

modern.text: There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.

original.text: אֵין מְתֹ֣ם בִּ֭בְשָׂרִי מִפְּנֵ֣י זַעְמֶ֑ךָ אֵין שָׁל֥וֹם בַּ֝עֲצָמַ֗י מִפְּנֵ֥י חַטָּאתִֽי

verses.restored: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

familiar.text: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

modern.text: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.

original.text: כִּ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹתַי עָבְר֣וּ רֹאשִׁ֑י כְּמַשָּׂ֥א כָ֝בֵ֗ד יִכְבְּד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי

verses.restored: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.

familiar.text: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.

modern.text: My wounds are foul and festering because of my sinful folly.

original.text: הִבְאִ֣ישׁוּ נָ֭מַקּוּ חַבּוּרֹתָ֑י מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י אִוַּלְתִּֽי

verses.restored: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

familiar.text: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

modern.text: I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.

original.text: נַעֲוֵ֣יתִי שַׁחֹ֣תִי עַד מְאֹ֑ד כָּל הַ֝יּ֗וֹם קֹדֵ֥ר הִלָּֽכְתִּי

verses.restored: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.

familiar.text: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.

modern.text: For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.

original.text: כִּֽי כְ֭סָלַי מָלְא֣וּ נִקְלֶ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין מְ֝תֹ֗ם בִּבְשָׂרִֽי

verses.restored: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

familiar.text: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

modern.text: I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.

original.text: נְפוּג֣וֹתִי וְנִדְכֵּ֣יתִי עַד מְאֹ֑ד שָׁ֝אַ֗גְתִּי מִֽנַּהֲמַ֥ת לִבִּֽי

verses.restored: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

familiar.text: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

modern.text: O Lord, my every desire is before You; my groaning is not hidden from You.

original.text: אֲֽדֹנָי נֶגְדְּךָ֥ כָל תַּאֲוָתִ֑י וְ֝אַנְחָתִ֗י מִמְּךָ֥ לֹא נִסְתָּֽרָה

verses.restored: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

familiar.text: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

modern.text: My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.

original.text: לִבִּ֣י סְ֭חַרְחַר עֲזָבַ֣נִי כֹחִ֑י וְֽאוֹר עֵינַ֥י גַּם הֵ֝֗ם אֵ֣ין אִתִּֽי

verses.restored: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

familiar.text: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

modern.text: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.

original.text: אֹֽהֲבַ֨י וְרֵעַ֗י מִנֶּ֣גֶד נִגְעִ֣י יַעֲמֹ֑דוּ וּ֝קְרוֹבַ֗י מֵרָחֹ֥ק עָמָֽדוּ

verses.restored: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

familiar.text: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

modern.text: Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.

original.text: וַיְנַקְשׁ֤וּ מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י נַפְשִׁ֗י וְדֹרְשֵׁ֣י רָ֭עָתִי דִּבְּר֣וּ הַוּ֑וֹת וּ֝מִרְמ֗וֹת כָּל הַיּ֥וֹם יֶהְגּֽוּ

verses.restored: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

familiar.text: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

modern.text: But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.

original.text: וַאֲנִ֣י כְ֭חֵרֵשׁ לֹ֣א אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וּ֝כְאִלֵּ֗ם לֹ֣א יִפְתַּח פִּֽיו

verses.restored: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.

familiar.text: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.

modern.text: I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.

original.text: וָאֱהִ֗י כְּ֭אִישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא שֹׁמֵ֑עַ וְאֵ֥ין בְּ֝פִ֗יו תּוֹכָחֽוֹת

verses.restored: For in thee, O YHWH, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

familiar.text: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

modern.text: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.

original.text: כִּֽי לְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה הוֹחָ֑לְתִּי אַתָּ֥ה תַ֝עֲנֶ֗ה אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהָֽי

verses.restored: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

familiar.text: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

modern.text: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me— those who taunt me when my foot slips.”

original.text: כִּֽי אָ֭מַרְתִּי פֶּן יִשְׂמְחוּ לִ֑י בְּמ֥וֹט רַ֝גְלִ֗י עָלַ֥י הִגְדִּֽילוּ

verses.restored: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.

familiar.text: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.

modern.text: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.

original.text: כִּֽי אֲ֭נִי לְצֶ֣לַע נָכ֑וֹן וּמַכְאוֹבִ֖י נֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד

verses.restored: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

familiar.text: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

modern.text: Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.

original.text: כִּֽי עֲוֺנִ֥י אַגִּ֑יד אֶ֝דְאַ֗ג מֵֽחַטָּאתִֽי

verses.restored: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

familiar.text: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

modern.text: Many are my enemies without cause, and many hate me without reason.

original.text: וְֽ֭אֹיְבַי חַיִּ֣ים עָצֵ֑מוּ וְרַבּ֖וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י שָֽׁקֶר

verses.restored: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.

familiar.text: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.

modern.text: Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.

original.text: וּמְשַׁלְּמֵ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה יִ֝שְׂטְנ֗וּנִי תַּ֣חַת רדופי טֽוֹב

verses.restored: Forsake me not, O YHWH: O my God, be not far from me.

familiar.text: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.

modern.text: Do not forsake me, O LORD; be not far from me, O my God.

original.text: אַל תַּֽעַזְבֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אַל תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנִּי

verses.restored: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

familiar.text: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

modern.text: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.

original.text: ח֥וּשָׁה לְעֶזְרָתִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י תְּשׁוּעָתִֽי

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: The speaker’s interpretation of sickness must not be universalized into illness-as-punishment or disability stigma.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
